holdout_state: already consumed development week; not blind out-of-sample
cash_window: exchange cash open inclusive, cash close exclusive; normal session 09:30-16:00
hypothesis: Fixed preopen volatility-scaled horizontal targets can be evaluated for cash-session touches without using target-session prices.
input_scope: completed prior cash sessions only; no target open, premarket, overnight quotes or live target-day IV
reference: last one-minute close of previous cash session; fixed throughout target session
historical_cash_variance: sum squared log returns from first cash bar open through successive cash minute closes; normalize each prior session to 390 minutes, average last 20, rescale to target cash length
option_iv: mean decimal annual IV of call and put at the nearest common eligible strike to prior cash close, expiration at next cash session; final prior cash minute only
option_quality: positive finite bid/ask/IV; uncrossed quotes; relative spread <=0.20; absolute iv_error <=0.01; 0.10<=abs(delta)<=0.90; underlying interval within prior cash session and price within 1% of reference
sigma_interpretation: cash-session dollar scale estimated from historical realized variance, adjusted by a dimensionless IV ratio; heuristic, not a calibrated probability or direct risk-neutral-to-physical conversion
benchmark_sigma: reference * sqrt(historical_cash_variance); identical anchors, multipliers and scoring
rounding: nearest cent, Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP, applied before scoring
probability_definition: 2*(1-Phi(z)) is a one-sided fixed-line touch probability for continuous zero-drift Brownian motion starting at the reference at cash open. Actual opening gaps violate this starting assumption; percentages are theoretical labels only.
primary_outcome: cash one-minute bar range overlaps fixed line (low <= line <= high); first such minute retained. Bar overlap does not certify an execution at the exact cent.
secondary_outcomes: opening already beyond directional line, directional threshold reached, and unconfirmed crossing between cash bars; opening beyond alone is NOT scored as a touch
calibration: none; all rules frozen before scoring; later forecasts may use earlier completed sessions in this week as prior history
data_vintage: retrospective latest ThetaData archive; publication vintage and exact snapshot event age not certified as-seen
publication_assumption: prior cash records assumed available by 17:15 Eastern on their session; projections reconstructed now, not historically published at 09:25
costs_and_trades: not applicable: target-touch diagnostic, no positions, orders, fills or P&L
completion_criteria: five causally generated fixed forecasts, five complete cash sessions, matched benchmark, preserved source hashes, daily chart/table and independently checked touch counts
promotion_criteria: none; five sessions cannot establish a 70% touch probability or live readiness
excluded: reversal/containment scoring; full composite feature fitting; following-week evaluation; FXReplay installation
